title: Webhook configuration and event types
content:
## Setting up a webhook
1. Go to **Settings → Webhooks → Add Webhook**.
2. Enter your endpoint URL (must be HTTPS in production).
3. Select the events to subscribe to.
4. Copy the **Webhook Secret** — used for signature verification.
5. Click **Save and Test** to send a test payload.

## Available event types

| Event | Trigger |
|-------|---------|
| `alert.fired` | An alert threshold was breached |
| `alert.resolved` | An alert returned to normal |
| `integration.connected` | A cloud account was successfully connected |
| `integration.failed` | A cloud integration lost connectivity |
| `user.invited` | A team member was invited |
| `billing.payment_failed` | A payment attempt failed |
| `billing.invoice_created` | A new invoice was generated |

## Payload format
```json
{
  "event": "alert.fired",
  "timestamp": "2026-04-15T10:30:00Z",
  "account_id": "acc_123",
  "data": {
    "alert_id": "alert_456",
    "alert_name": "CPU > 90%",
    "severity": "high",
    "resource": "i-0abc123"
  }
}
```

## Signature verification
Verify the `X-CloudDash-Signature` header:
```python
import hmac, hashlib

def verify_signature(secret, payload_body, signature):
    expected = hmac.new(
        secret.encode(), payload_body, hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature)
```
